exercises.question: What is the best advice for someone who often feels tired?
options: Conviene que revise sus hábitos de sueño. [It is advisable that they review their sleep habits.]
Conviene que revisa sus hábitos de sueño. [It is advisable that they review their sleep habits.]
Conviene que revisará sus hábitos de sueño. [It is advisable that they review their sleep habits.]

exercises.sentence: Si te sientes cansado con frecuencia, conviene que __ tus hábitos de sueño.
exercises.english: If you often feel tired, it is advisable that you review your sleep habits.
I usually walk every day because that way I feel more energetic.

sentences: Me siento cansado con frecuencia. [I often feel tired.]
Reviso mis hábitos de sueño. [I review my sleep habits.]
Después cambio mi rutina para descansar mejor. [Then I change my routine to rest better.]

exercises.question: Which sentence gives a piece of advice and a reason for it?
options: Se recomienda descansar bien, ya que la falta de sueño puede afectar al bienestar. [It is recommended to rest well, since lack of sleep can affect wellbeing.]
Se recomienda descansar bien en una habitación tranquila. [It is recommended to rest well in a quiet room.]
Se recomienda descansar bien, pero la falta de sueño puede afectar al bienestar. [It is recommended to rest well, but lack of sleep can affect wellbeing.]

exercises.sentence: Es importante que la rutina sea __.
exercises.english: It is important that the routine be balanced.

exercises.question: What does Gregor find out when he wakes up one morning?
options: Que había cambiado y era un insecto enorme. [That he had changed and was a huge insect.]
Que había perdido su trabajo en la oficina. [That he had lost his job at the office.]
Que su familia se había ido de la casa. [That his family had left the house.]

exercises.question: Why are the people at the door afraid?
options: Porque oyen un ruido raro, no la voz de una persona. [Because they hear a strange noise, not a person's voice.]
Porque Gregor abre la puerta y sale corriendo. [Because Gregor opens the door and runs out.]
Porque Gregor llama a la policía desde su cama. [Because Gregor calls the police from his bed.]

exercises.question: What had Gregor done for years?
options: Había trabajado mucho como vendedor para ayudar a su familia. [He had worked hard as a salesman to help his family.]
Había viajado de vacaciones con sus padres y su hermana. [He had travelled on holiday with his parents and sister.]
Había descansado casi todos los días en su cama. [He had rested in his bed almost every day.]

exercises.sentence: Si te sientes cansado con frecuencia, conviene que revises tus hábitos de sueño.
options: If you often feel tired, it is advisable that you review your sleep habits.
If you sleep well, you should stop exercising.
If you feel tired yesterday, you will review your habits tomorrow.

exercises.sentence: Suelo caminar todos los días porque así me siento con más energía.
options: I usually walk every day because that way I feel more energetic.
Yesterday I walked for a long time because I felt very tired.
Tomorrow I will walk to the clinic because I feel a little ill.

exercises.sentence: Se recomienda descansar bien, ya que la falta de sueño puede afectar al bienestar.
exercises.english: It is recommended to rest well, since lack of sleep can affect wellbeing.

exercises.sentence: Para recuperarse mejor, es importante que la rutina sea equilibrada.
options: To recover better, it is important that the routine be balanced.
To recover better, the routine should become longer.
To improve sleep, the routine must be cancelled.

template.prompt: Advise someone to sleep well because lack of sleep can affect wellbeing, then say that you usually rest eight hours.
template.answer: Te recomiendo que duermas bien porque la falta de sueño puede afectar al bienestar. Suelo descansar ocho horas.

template.prompt: Say that it is recommended to have a balanced routine and exercise every day to improve quality of life.
template.answer: Se recomienda tener una rutina equilibrada y hacer ejercicio todos los días para mejorar la calidad de vida.
